1	# InkOS Marketing Site
2	
3	## Project
4	Marketing site for InkOS — the studio OS for tattoo. Built on Stack A (Next.js 16.2.3 + TypeScript strict).
5	
6	## Stack
7	- Next.js 16.2.3, React 19.2.4, TypeScript strict
8	- Tailwind CSS v4 (@tailwindcss/postcss, no tailwind.config.ts)
9	- Framer Motion for all animations
10	- Lucide React for icons
11	- Path alias: @/* → ./src/*
12	
13	## Brand
14	- Brand constants: `src/lib/brand.ts`
15	- Tokens in CSS: `src/app/globals.css` (@theme inline)
16	- Fonts: Instrument Serif (serif headlines) + Inter (sans body) via next/font/google
17	
18	## Rules
19	- No `any` types. No `@ts-ignore`.
20	- All motion components must have "use client"
21	- Import brand constants from @/lib/brand, never hardcode hex values
